Movements And Drawing Paths

  1. Home
  2. Movements And Drawing Paths

Instructor

Muizudeen Kusimo

Muizz is an experienced software engineer with a knack for simplifying complex topics.

This lesson explores the commands used to move objects (i.e. sprites) around and draw paths in a program. Participants also learn how to repeat one or more actions
